name: Pakistani Haleem
description: Slow-cooked Pakistani haleem made with beef, wheat, barley and mixed lentils, finished with fried onions, ginger, lemon and fresh herbs.
ingredients: 750 g beef, boneless or shank pieces
Fried onions, ginger, coriander and lemon for serving
method: Wash the wheat, barley and lentils, then soak them for 1 hour.
Cook the grains and lentils in plenty of water until very soft.
In another pot, fry onions, add ginger-garlic paste, beef and spices, then cook until the beef is tender.
Shred the cooked beef and return it to the masala.
Blend or mash the cooked grains until thick and smooth, then combine them with the beef mixture.
Cook on low heat, stirring regularly, until the haleem becomes glossy and stretchy.
Serve hot with fried onions, julienned ginger, coriander and lemon.
